$comment: Mutation arms cutting the types of package anyparse.query.format.json. Format and rules: docs/testing.md, Declared arms.

arms.name: M-ARMRECORDS-ONE-CUT
arms.note: a record that cuts two ways is reported as a stray replace instead of as the two cuts it declares

arms.name: M-ARMRECORDS-UNKNOWN-KEY
arms.note: a misspelled key is written into the registry, where its record then cuts nothing

arms.name: M-ARMRECORDS-APPEND-LOST
arms.note: the document comes back as it was, so the record the pinned test names never reaches the registry

arms.name: M-ARMRECORDS-VALUE-KIND
arms.note: a value that is not a string, or a list of them for a cut, is written into the registry as null

arms.name: M-ARMRECORDS-NAME-KIND
arms.note: a name that is not a string is reported as a missing name, which sends the author to the wrong key
